description: Small literature-search sample in the style of LitSearch (Asai et al., 2024; arXiv:2407.18940). Each query lists its gold (ground-truth) papers as arXiv identifiers plus title. Scoring is recall of gold papers within the retrieved web documents. Curated from well-attested ML/NLP papers; not the full 597-query LitSearch release.
